name: 421-mixedprompt-13b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1: one in-process vLLM engine.
architecture: dense LlamaForCausalLM, 40 layers, 40 query and 40 KV heads (MHA), head_dim 128, hidden 5120, intermediate 13824, vocab 32000, context window 2048, float16; 13.0B parameters, ~26 GB of fp16 weights.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=256, NO warmup, bounded at 1000 requests with an 1800 s safety cap. The whole 1000-request batch is scored, ramp and drain included, because that is exactly the window the reference driver `benchmark_throughput.py --num-prompts=1000` times. A percent warmup must not be reintroduced: on a request-bounded closed loop guidellm opens the measure window at the dispatch time of whichever request happens to be the 501st to complete, which can fall anywhere from a few seconds to nearly a minute into the run -- a window-start jitter large enough to swamp the measurement.
workload: `configs/data/sharegpt-1000-vicuna13b.jsonl`, 1000 real ShareGPT_V3 conversations, single turn each -- the first human turn is the prompt and the length of the first assistant turn is the output length. 233094 prompt + 245124 output tokens over the 1000 rows; prompt lengths mean 233, median 95, p90 665, max 1024; output lengths mean 245, median 157, p90 618, max 1850. `configs/data/make-dataset.py` regenerates the draw (filters, served tokenizer, `random.seed(0)`, `random.sample`). Sampling: temperature 1.0, top_p 1.0, top_k -1, n=1, no beam search, no penalties, no logprobs, and `ignore_eos` so each request generates exactly its row's output length. `request_format: plain` hands the raw prompt string to the engine; this checkpoint's tokenizer_config.json defines no chat template.
purpose: A 13-billion-parameter chat assistant handling varied real conversations with 256 concurrent users on a single GPU.
launch:
# vLLM v0.1.4 (2023-08-25) `EngineArgs`: an unknown key is a TypeError at engine construction, not
# a warning. Add nothing here that this version does not already define.
#
# This file is read line by line as `key: value`, and a value beginning `{` or `[` is parsed as
# JSON. An indented YAML block never reaches the engine args, so keep every value on one line.

model: lmsys/vicuna-13b-v1.3
tensor-parallel-size: 1
pipeline-parallel-size: 1
dtype: float16

# The six below are this engine's own defaults, written out so a default cannot drift.
max-num-batched-tokens: 2560
max-num-seqs: 256
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.9
block-size: 16
swap-space: 4
seed: 0
